description: Run a unified Grafana data-source query (POST /api/ds/query) on the tenant's Grafana connection — PromQL/Loki/SQL etc. via a data source. Required: queries (array of Grafana query objects, each with a datasource). Optional: from, to.

from.description: Start of the query time range

queries.description: Grafana query objects, each with a datasource

to.description: End of the query time range

name: query_grafana
